headline: Derby AC Milan – Inter at 20:45 (~75,000) on Halloween night
taxi: San Siro arrivals 18:30–20:30 and exits 22:45–00:30, then centre nightlife until late: busiest night of the week.
linate: Long weekend (All Saints, Sun 1 Nov): Saturday departures and arrivals, plus away-from-home derby fans.

headline: All Saints' Day (Sunday): quiet city after the derby night
taxi: Light demand; cemeteries in the morning, station returns in the evening.
linate: Evening returns from the long weekend; Bob Dylan fans arrive for Monday.

headline: Bob Dylan at Unipol Dome Santa Giulia; EICMA exhibitors arrive
linate: Busy: EICMA trade visitors and exhibitors fly in ahead of Tue 3 Nov press days.

headline: EICMA press/trade days start at Rho, plus SMAU and Marco Masini
taxi: Rho Fiera at 08:30 opening and 18:30 closing; Assago exits around 23:30.
linate: Very busy: international EICMA trade visitors arriving.

headline: EICMA trade days at Rho plus SMAU at MiCo
taxi: Rho Fiera at 08:30 and 18:30; CityLife at closing; hotels and centre in the evening.
linate: Very busy: EICMA trade visitors and exhibitors; arrivals ahead of Thursday's public opening.

headline: EICMA public days open, SIRM radiology congress starts and AC Milan – Ferencváros at 18:45
taxi: Rho Fiera all day; San Siro arrivals 17:00–18:45 and exits 20:45–21:30 on the west side.
linate: Very busy: radiology delegates, EICMA visitors and Hungarian away fans.

headline: EICMA public day and SIRM congress on a Friday
taxi: Rho Fiera all day, heaviest at 18:30 closing; MiCo/CityLife at congress close; centre Friday evening.
linate: Busy: SIRM delegates and EICMA visitors; Friday arrivals for the EICMA weekend.

headline: EICMA Saturday at Rho (biggest crowd), SIRM congress and Nayt at Assago
taxi: Rho Fiera all day, peak at 18:30 closing; Assago exits around 23:30; centre Saturday night.
linate: Busy: weekend EICMA visitors and SIRM delegates departing.
